title: Death of Aurangzeb begins the Mughal decline
summary: The Mughal emperor Aurangzeb died at Ahmednagar in the Deccan, aged 88, after nearly fifty years on the throne.
reason: His long wars against the Marathas and his successors' struggles over the throne had drained the empire.
significance: The Mughal Empire fragmented soon after, opening India to regional powers and European companies.
